**Feature Description**
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

**Problem or Use Case**
What problem does this feature solve? Please provide concrete use cases.

**Architectural Scope Alignment**
> [!NOTE]
> Ava AI's core architecture is feature-complete, frozen-weight, and strictly non-vector-RAG:
> `AVA = LLM + Session Memory + Persistent Factual Memory + Behavioral Preference Learning + Feedback-Driven Strategy Learning + Closed-Loop Behavioral Adaptation`.
> We do NOT accept proposals to introduce vector databases (FAISS/Chroma/Pinecone), embedding-based semantic retrieval, or online model fine-tuning.

- [ ] I confirm this proposal aligns with Ava's non-vector-RAG architecture and operational maintenance goals.

**Proposed Implementation / Design**
How do you envision this being integrated into existing modules?

**Alternatives Considered**
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you have evaluated.
